prompt.project_info: Create a casual, candid outdoor fashion portrait of an approved adult woman in a bohemian red floral dress beside a textured stone wall.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with fair skin and long dark chestnut-brown loose waves, a natural finish, and an introspective downward gaze partly framed by hair. She wears a red floral off-the-shoulder mini dress with puffed short sleeves, a sweetheart neckline, a corset-style bodice, and a ruffled tiered skirt, plus a thin black choker, silver rings, and a red beaded bracelet. She holds a dark green crocodile-texture cowboy boot.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium thigh-up portrait at eye level, subject leaning against an irregular grey-and-beige stone masonry wall with her body slightly angled. Her right hand rests gently near the chest/neck, left hand holds the green boot downward, and her gaze remains downward. Keep the dress, boot, jewelry, wall texture, and soft negative space visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight, diffused even front illumination, and gentle shadows. Preserve the casual, slightly moody, artistic bohemian mood with soft-grunge undertones.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end photorealistic portrait, 85mm prime lens, f/2.8, eye-level medium crop, sharp focus on subject and fabric, shallow wall separation, realistic skin pores, fabric, leather, and stone texture, natural grain.
